evidence_items.explanation: This supports the narrower data-scaling premise for tested multimodal models and concepts. It does not measure financial expenditure or establish the claimed relationship for every successive model improvement.

The study reports improved model performance alongside lower downstream compute requirements, cautioning against a universal cost rule. These are different cost categories and an earlier period, so this is not decisive contradiction.
